from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single cash finding extracted from one document's financial statements."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The legal name of the company filing the document")
    cash_line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used in the balance sheet for the cash amount")
    reported_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value as reported in the text")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    reporting_period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date the financial statement period ended")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_records: list[CompanyCashRecord]
